metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill addressing thread-safe singleton client retrieval via double-checked locking pattern. It differs semantically and operationally from existing skills: ThreadPoolExecutor initialization (worker thread setup), Submit Callable (async task dispatch), and peer candidates (agent instantiation, observability setup). No existing skill covers the double-checked locking pattern for singleton client retrieval. Peer candidates operate in different task families (agent_instantiation, agent_observability_setup) and do not overlap. Support evidence from Debugging Roadmap validates the pattern. Safe to persist as new capability.
